name: Vivaa Tradecom Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Vivaa Tradecom Ltd is in the business of trading in denim and non denim products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
VTL offers quality and range wide denim and non denim fabrics and denim garments, catering to international and domestic markets. Its denim and non denim fabrics are supplied in 100% cotton, cotton polyester and cotton lycra blends in a range of widths and weaves. Vivaa denim jean brands are available in different styles, fits,and in varied colours and finishes

pros: Stock is trading at 0.76 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.53% over last 3 years.
